species.tagline: The little snail all over the rocks

tasks.title: Look at its shell
tasks.message: The shell is covered in bumps and is very hard — the waves cannot break it.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a rock snail. Its bumpy shell is hard enough for the waves.

tasks.title: Where it lives
tasks.message: Hong Kong's rocky shores are covered in them. Go at low tide and you will see.
tasks.subtitle: They are all over Hong Kong's rocky shores. Go at low tide and look.

tasks.title: Help it
tasks.message: Put back any rock you turn over, so they still have a home.
tasks.subtitle: Put the rocks back and they still have a home. Thank you!
